generation_settings.method: Direct agent-authored independent requests and rival intents; CPU serialization and shuffled choices only.

sampling.note: Harness settings unavailable; no API calls made.

generation_settings.source_format: One authored group per line: short group ID|state|teacher target text|rival texts. Correct source choice is first; exported positions are balanced and randomized.
generation_settings.question: What is the primary intent of this request?
generation_settings.position_method: Seeded shuffled balanced schedules independently within split and option count; independently shuffled rivals.

usage_constraints.origin: Original synthetic text generated using existing approved agent access under existing provider terms.
usage_constraints.redistribution: No independent redistribution-license claim; subject to applicable provider terms.
usage_constraints.privacy: No private customer or company records used.
usage_constraints.features: Only state, question and option text are model inputs. IDs, targets, provenance and assignments are metadata.
usage_constraints.validation: Validation labels are for validation only, not weight updates.

limitations: Teacher-authored labels and same-session semantic review are not independently verified correctness.
Immutable teacher revision and provider sampling parameters were not exposed.
No tokenizer or ML was loaded; the parent must audit the 256-token pair budget.
Historical shards and other producer data were not inspected; global deduplication remains a parent gate.
Domains and singleton scenario plans are distinct; generic request categories intentionally recur.
